name: Post-Quantum Migration and Legacy Signature Sunset
nameZh: 抗量子迁移与遗留签名淘汰
summary: A phased migration plan: Phase A (3 years) blocks new funds to vulnerable addresses; Phase B (5 years) invalidates ECDSA/Schnorr signatures entirely; Phase C explores ZK-proof recovery for frozen funds. ~6.7M BTC currently in vulnerable addresses.
summaryZh: 分阶段迁移计划：A阶段（3年）阻止向脆弱地址发送新资金；B阶段（5年）完全淘汰 ECDSA/Schnorr 签名；C阶段探索使用零知识证明恢复被冻结的资金。目前约670万 BTC 位于脆弱地址中。
